verdict.rationale: Conductor orchestrates real coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode) that implement features/fixes via chat, each given its own workspace, branch, and diff view across files, and can run builds/tests autonomously without per-step confirmation. Community feedback confirms it functions as a natural extension of Claude Code's plain-language coding workflow. Missing for 10: no first-party or hands-on example of a specific plain-language feature/bug request being multi-file resolved, and quality of underlying code-gen is delegated to third-party agents rather than demonstrated by Conductor itself.
